# supplier-rules/

## Endpoints / Modules
PRD-05 Phase 3 supplier coding rules CRUD. Rules gate the auto-publish decision in `autoPublishGateService`.

- `GET  /api/accounting/supplier-rules` — list all rules for the company, joined with `suppliers.name` + `gl_accounts.account_code/name`.
- `POST /api/accounting/supplier-rules` — upsert. Body `{ supplierId, ...patch }` where patch is a subset of `SupplierRule` fields (defaults filled server-side: `autoPublish=false`, `autoPublishMinConfidence=0.95`, `qtyTolerancePct=2`, `priceTolerancePct=2`).
- `GET    /api/accounting/supplier-rules/[supplierId]` — get-or-null.
- `PATCH  /api/accounting/supplier-rules/[supplierId]` — COALESCE-patch; omitted fields retained.
- `DELETE /api/accounting/supplier-rules/[supplierId]` — hard delete.

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))` for all verbs (read is behind auth because it exposes per-supplier auto-publish state).

## Request / Response
SupplierRule shape: `{id, companyId, supplierId, supplierName?, defaultGlAccountId, defaultGlAccountCode?, defaultGlAccountName?, defaultVatCode, defaultCostCentreId, defaultProjectId, autoPublish, autoPublishMaxAmount, autoPublishMinConfidence, requirePoMatch, qtyTolerancePct, priceTolerancePct, learnedSampleCount, learnedFromLastCorrectionAt, updatedBy, createdAt, updatedAt}`.

## Business rules
- **Auto-publish is off by default.** Creating a rule doesn't enable it; the UI surfaces a toggle + confirmation.
- **Learning loop writes through `recordCoding` (not this endpoint).** Users edit rules here; the system writes via the invoice-posting paths. The two never fight — on drift, `recordCoding` overwrites defaults (see `supplierRulesService.recordCoding`).
- **`qtyTolerancePct` + `priceTolerancePct`** are independent (migration 413). The pure `validateThreeWayMatch` util accepts both separately as of commit f526445.
